name: TripoSR
tagline: Fast feed-forward 3D reconstruction model that converts a single 2D image into a textured 3D mesh in under a second.
real_test_summary: Tested converting single product and character PNG images into textured OBJ and GLB meshes locally on a 6GB VRAM GPU. Exports usable base 3D geometry in a few seconds offline.
pros: Reconstructs textured 3D meshes from a single image in seconds
Fits within 6GB VRAM GPUs and also supports slower CPU fallback mode
Permissive MIT license with clean OBJ and GLB export for Blender
cons: Back-side geometry inferred from single views can look soft or low-detail
Generated textures require cleanup for production game or film assets
